scope: One owned bounded CPU constructor-only lossless roundtrip per exact saved brick and foliage patch, with no retry, repair, alternate constructor or target generation.
reviewed_contract: Only the two hash-pinned accepted patch vertex, local-triangle and original-ID arrays are inputs; no full-model array, neural field, remesher or viewer is loaded.

Explicit allowNonManifoldEdge=True, duplicateNonManifoldVertices=False and shiftFaceId=0 match installed API stubs. Heap copies preserve independent expected inputs. Zero skipped/failed faces and dense unchanged valid native IDs are required.

Readback uses original native FaceId values, exact promoted F32 position bits including signed zero, and per-face original oriented triples allowing only recorded cyclic corner rotation. Added/dropped/merged/duplicated vertices or triangles, changed winding/order/multiplicity, input mutation and nonfinite data reject admission.
Private native readbacks are saved and reopened exactly. Observed native edge pairing is reported without asserting original sheet correspondence.

Fixed installed Python -I -B blocks on binary GO before numerical/native imports. Host attaches its unnamed owned Job before GO; process and Job limits are both 6 GiB, with 180-second host and 150-second cooperative budgets, 12 GiB RAM and 2 GiB disk floors, private CWD/TEMP, exact source/manifest watches and natural unforced empty-Job requirement.

Pinned historical CPU audit guard plus additional CUDA/viewer import and mutation guards are installed before NumPy/MeshLib imports. Unexpected native/API/runtime faults preserve their row then stop the whole worker; only intentional measured AdmissionError contract rejections can proceed to the other fixed patch.
limitations: GO qualifies this source and bounded constructor experiment only. Actual native transport is not yet measured; remeshing, clean target geometry, appearance transfer and exports remain unqualified.
Lossless construction does not establish trusted original pairing at non-manifold junctions, or certify that subsequent remeshing preserves sheets, thin features, gaps or boundaries.
PE review covers declared normal/delay dependencies. Dynamic LoadLibrary/plugin behavior and runtime driver activity have not been measured; Python audit hooks are not a native binary sandbox.
